```{r data}
# Fifty countries, each variable averaged over 1960 to 1970.
life <- LifeCycleSavings

# Body weight (kg) and brain weight (g) for 62 species.
data(mammals, package = "MASS")

# The spread ratio: residual SD in the top third of fitted values
# over the bottom third. Near 1 means the spread is even.
spread_ratio <- function(m) {
  third <- cut(fitted(m), quantile(fitted(m), 0:3 / 3), include.lowest = TRUE)
  s <- tapply(resid(m), third, sd)
  s[[3]] / s[[1]]
}
```
